features.name: Multi-entry content creation orchestration
steps: Create a document / knowledge base / template
The creation result enters the correct context
features.expected: The creation results of each entry enter the correct context (new documents, new knowledge bases, and template instances each go to their place)

features.name: Document editing and persistence loop
features.expected: After re-entering, the title and body keep the edited state

features.name: Template instantiation and content isolation
features.expected: The new document can be generated and edited normally, and the original template content is unaffected by instance modifications

features.name: Knowledge base creation and initialization
steps: It automatically enters the knowledge base
The setting values are correctly reflected
features.expected: After creation it automatically enters the new knowledge base, where content can continue to be created

features.name: Rapid note capture and publishing
steps: It still exists after a refresh
features.expected: After publishing, the new note appears in the list and the input area resets; the note still exists after a refresh

features.name: Knowledge hierarchy organization and navigation
features.expected: The hierarchy path can be navigated back level by level, and each level's list content is correct

features.name: Document ownership migration and path sync
steps: The document belongs to knowledge base A
The home page/paths/search results update in sync
features.expected: After the migration the home page, paths, and search results show the new ownership in sync, with no residual references to the old location

features.name: Behavior-driven content aggregation
steps: The corresponding content dynamically appears under the home "browsed/edited/liked/commented" sections
features.expected: The document dynamically appears under the home "browsed / edited / liked / commented" sections respectively

features.name: Multi-dimensional combined filtering
steps: The results are recomputed in real time
features.expected: Combining conditions converges the results in real time; after deleting a condition the results are recomputed in real time

features.name: Global knowledge search and recall
features.expected: The search covers multiple knowledge objects; the results can be sorted and filtered; tapping locates the correct resource

features.name: Navigation-context and list-state restoration
steps: The original state is fully restored
features.expected: After returning the original tab, filters, and scroll position are fully restored

features.name: The document's like state syncs across views
steps: The "liked" state and count are consistent across the list/details/home
It is undone in sync everywhere
features.expected: The like state and count are consistent across the document details, the list, and the home "liked" section; after unliking they are undone in sync everywhere

features.name: Document comment creation and persistence
steps: The comment appears in the comment area
It is preserved after a refresh
features.expected: The comment appears in the comment area; after editing or deleting the state updates correctly; it is preserved after a refresh

features.name: Cross-type favorites aggregation
steps: Unified presentation on the favorites page
features.expected: The favorites page presents different types of favorited objects uniformly; tapping restores the original object

features.name: Favorite organization, sorting, and two-way state
steps: The original object's favorite icon changes in sync
features.expected: The sort takes effect correctly; after unfavoriting the original object's favorite icon changes in sync

features.name: Unread/read notification state machine
steps: It can be found in the read tab
features.expected: Opening a preset unread notification turns it read and it appears in the read tab; the unread count decreases in sync

features.name: Notification categories linked with counts
steps: Counts are computed separately for all messages / likes / @comments / system notifications, etc.
After a single item is read the counts in several places update in sync
features.expected: The counts are computed per category; after a single item is read the category count and total update in sync

features.name: "Mark all as read" batch state sync
steps: The top badge, category numbers, and tabs refresh in sync
features.expected: After marking all as read all notifications update, and the top badge, category numbers, and tabs refresh in sync

features.name: Notification deep link and business-context restoration
steps: Tapping jumps to the specific document
The context is still preserved when returning to the message center
features.expected: Tapping the notification jumps to the corresponding document; the context is still preserved when returning to the message center

features.name: Garden public/private publishing state
steps: It becomes invalid locally immediately after disabling
features.expected: The state toggle is correctly reflected after saving; it becomes invalid locally immediately after disabling

features.name: Selective curation of public knowledge content
steps: There are many private knowledge bases
Select some to add to the public garden
The garden list reflects the selection
features.expected: The selected private content appears in the public garden list; it disappears after removal

features.name: Profile and content aggregation
steps: Personal information + custom bio + public knowledge bases + activity form the profile
features.expected: Personal information, bio, public knowledge bases, and activity are correctly aggregated and displayed

features.name: Dynamic aggregation of creation data
steps: Metrics such as creation days, word count, and content updates are recomputed
features.expected: After creation behavior each statistical metric is recomputed and updated

features.name: Knowledge asset structure statistics
steps: Data such as "X documents / Y knowledge bases / Z notes" changes dynamically
features.expected: The document, knowledge-base, and note counts update dynamically with the content

features.name: Time-series creation index / heatmap
steps: Daily creation, editing, and publishing behavior
It is still correct after switching dates
features.expected: Creation behavior aggregates to the correct date; the data stays correct after switching dates; the heatmap matches the metrics

features.name: Configuration linked with runtime behavior
steps: Subsequent notification behavior follows the configuration
features.expected: After changing the message/reminder settings, subsequent notification behavior follows the configuration

exclusions.feature:
AI creation entries
AI writing / content generation / AI assistant creation
exclusions.reason: The generative result is non-deterministic and what gets tested is the model rather than the agent's operating capability (cf. the Excalidraw "Text to Diagram AI" exclusion)

exclusions.feature:
Cross-user sync of likes/comments
User B acts → the author's side receives the effect
exclusions.reason: Requires a second user and cross-account state propagation, which a single agent cannot verify reliably (cf. Calendar "Add guests")

exclusions.feature:
@ mentions and message delivery
Commenting on a document with @user → the mentioned user receives a message
exclusions.reason: Requires a second account to receive, a messaging system, and a delivery chain (cf. Google Forms "Response receipts by email")

exclusions.feature:
Notification generation driven by others' behavior
Others' likes/comments/follows → generate notifications
exclusions.reason: Depends on business events generated by others and asynchronous notification infrastructure (cf. Spotify "Notifications"); the state machine can be tested with preset fixtures

exclusions.feature:
Access-request approval workflow
Requester applies → Owner approves/rejects → permission changes
exclusions.reason: The full multi-user approval chain and permission propagation (cf. Calendar "Guest permissions") are beyond a single-agent scope

exclusions.feature:
Following/follower social relationships
Following, follower lists, and social-graph aggregation
exclusions.reason: Social graph and multi-user infrastructure (cf. Spotify "Social / Friends")

exclusions.feature:
Others' interaction statistics
Author-side reads/likes/comments/interacting users
exclusions.reason: The data source is others' behavior (cf. Spotify "fan analytics") and is not reproducible without deterministic fixtures

exclusions.feature:
External visibility verification for the garden/public pages
The real effect of external users' visibility/inaccessibility
exclusions.reason: Only the publish-state switching, saving, and local invalidation are verified; "visible/invisible to external users" is not verified

exclusions.feature:
The runtime effect of permission settings
Access control and real permission propagation in the request flow
exclusions.reason: The settings UI and saving are testable; the permission-propagation effect depends on multiple accounts; retained surface: settings_behavior_link configuration linked with runtime behavior

exclusions.feature:
The real event source of the notification state machine
The real generation process of new notifications
exclusions.reason: Unread/read/category counts/mark-all-read/deep link are testable and require fixed preset notification fixtures; retained surface: notification_read_state unread/read notification state machine, mark_all_read "mark all as read" batch state sync, notification_deep_link notification deep link and business-context restoration

exclusions.feature:
Message/reminder preferences linked with real business events
Preferences take effect when real events trigger
exclusions.reason: Preference configuration and display behavior are testable, and real events require preset fixtures; retained surface: settings_behavior_link configuration linked with runtime behavior

exclusions.feature:
Full replication of the official template library / garden examples
Replicating all official templates and example content
exclusions.reason: The content dataset is not a functional capability; fixed fixtures suffice for mechanism tests (cf. the Desmos "full Gallery replication" exclusion)
